no_logic_0.0.1.description: Adds "Generate No-Logic" to the Archipelago Launcher. This is implemented by forcing `accessibility: minimal`, and acting like every game can always reach its goal. Known Issues: - The Archipelago Launcher says "Opening new window", but the generation runs in the background. Either use the ArchipelagoLauncherDebug to see generation logging as it happens, or check the `logs` folder for the generation log.
